meta.name: humanize-text
meta.description: Rewrite AI-generated text to sound naturally human-written. Use when asked to humanize text, make writing sound less AI, bypass AI detection, rewrite for natural tone, or convert robotic/formal text to conversational style. Triggers on "humanize this", "make this sound human", "rewrite naturally", "anti-AI detection", or any request to remove AI tells from writing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把AI生成文字改写成自然的人类口吻
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要让AI写的文字读起来像真人写的。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite AI-generated text to sound naturally human.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make AI-written text sound human.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 AI 生成的文字改得像人写的：去掉完美语法、重复句式、AI 常用词（如“delve”“leverage”），加入口语化表达、个人观点和节奏变化。
howto.when: 当你要求“把这段文字改得像人写的”“绕过 AI 检测”“去掉 AI 味”，或提到“humanize this”“make this sound human”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这段话改得像人写的，去掉 AI 味。
say.note: Claude 会重写文本，加入口语和不完美。

say.text: 帮我绕过 AI 检测，改写这段文字。
say.note: Claude 会消除 AI 痕迹，降低检测风险。

say.text: 让这段文字读起来更自然，像真人聊天。
say.note: Claude 会调整节奏、用词和句式。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude rewrites AI-generated text to sound human: removes perfect grammar, repetitive patterns, and AI buzzwords (e.g., 'delve', 'leverage'), adds colloquial language, personal opinions, and varied rhythm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to 'humanize this', 'make this sound human', 'rewrite naturally', 'bypass AI detection', or any request to remove AI tells from writing.

say_en.text: Rewrite this to sound human, remove AI tone.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite with imperfections and casual style.

say_en.text: Help me bypass AI detection on this text.
say_en.note: Claude will eliminate AI tells and lower detection risk.

say_en.text: Make this text read naturally, like a real person wrote it.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust rhythm, word choice, and sentence structure.
